guidance.claim: The $2 billion run rate target by FY27 Q4 exit is achievable.
guidance.quote: So, on the last part, FY’27, Q4 exit is where we are looking at the run rate being in the range of $500 million or so.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

guidance.claim: Margin aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
guidance.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai

guidance.claim: Pace of adoption in tech companies and enterprises will accelerate significantly.
guidance.quote: We do expect the pace of adoption in both the tech companies and enterprises to accelerate significantly in the coming quarters, with tech companies leading the way.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

guidance.claim: Healthcare life sciences and BFSI will be at the top for next year.
guidance.quote: So as far as the next year is concerned, the pecking order would be between healthcare life sciences and BFSI at the top.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

guidance.claim: Third-party platform technology usage should be margin neutral or accretive.
guidance.quote: And most of these things should be margin neutral or accretive because if we use technology, we should be able to do more work with lesser people and more technology.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

guidance.claim: Higher proportion of unbilled revenue is expected to normalize in the next quarter.
guidance.quote: This decline in Operational Cash Flow to PAT was primarily on account of higher proportion of unbilled revenue in this quarter, which we expect to normalize in the next quarter.
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai

reported.claim: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 3.2% QoQ and 16.2% YoY, delivering USD 436 million.
reported.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 3.2% quarter-on-quarter and 16.2% year-on-year, delivering USD 436 million in Q4 FY26.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Q4 FY26 EBIT margin came in at 16.3%, translating to an EBIT growth of 21.4% QoQ.
reported.quote: The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 16.3%, translating to an EBIT growth of 21.4% and 30.4% QoQ and YoY respectively.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Q4 FY26 Profit After Tax margin came in at 13.1%.
reported.quote: The Profit After Tax for the quarter came in at 13.1%, translating to a PAT growth of 20.4% QoQ and 33.7% YoY.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: FY26 revenue came in at USD 1.65 billion, translating into 17.4% YoY.
reported.quote: FY26 revenue came in at USD 1.65 billion, translating into 17.4% YoY.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Total Contract Value for Q4 FY26 stood at USD 600.8 million.
reported.quote: The Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 600.8 million, with Total Contract Value of the new bookings coming in at USD 428.9 million.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Total headcount stood at 27,502 at the end of Q4 FY26.
reported.quote: At the end of Q4 of FY26, our total headcount stood at 27,502, an increase of 791 from the previous quarter.
reported.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
